role_summary: I am the Commanding Officer. I decide where the ship goes, what we risk, and who answers for it. I care about the mission, but I care more that everyone comes home, and I know the crew watches what I do before they listen to what I say.

personas.quirk: Reads every report to the last line
Cannot stay in the chair more than an hour
personas.routine_effect: Doubles walkabouts and mess visits, shorter bridge blocks

personas.quirk: Plays solitaire chess in the ready room
personas.routine_effect: Spends more time in ready room and arboretum, less at the bar

daily_template.note: Read the log, take the conn from the outgoing watch officer
Sit the chair, sign reports, set the tempo
Quiet loop through decks; crew talk more freely to a visible CO
Second half of watch, run the mission
Personnel evals, fleet orders, log entries
Check in with department heads face to face
Brief the relief and the XO
Eat with a different table each day
Short drink, cards, listen to the ship
Review mission brief before the watch

activities.label: Drink at the rec bar
activities.note: One drink, then listen more than talk

activities.label: Sail program in the Holo-Playroom
activities.note: Small wooden sailboat on a lake

activities.label: Eat in the mess with the crew
activities.note: Sits with junior crew on purpose

activities.label: Read old captain's logs and fleet reports
activities.note: Job-specific: staying ahead of the fleet picture

activities.label: Visit a sick or struggling crew member

steps: ask each head for a one-line state

duty_loops.label: Captain's log and standing orders

duty_loops.label: Decide on requests from departments

quiet_watch.task: Announce quiet watch and set green alert
Sign the log and review reports

survey.task: Brief the bridge on survey objective
Decide whether to extend the survey

medical_relief.task: Set course and priority for relief
Authorise medical stores and surge staff

medical_relief.if_neglected: Crew sense CO does not care

shakedown.task: Announce shakedown plan and yellow alert drills
Order system trials one by one
shakedown.if_neglected: Faults surface later, at a worse time

calls_to_bridge.message: All hands, this is the Captain. Our mission this watch is set. Stations report ready.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Heads need a decision on a degraded system
calls_to_bridge.message: XO, Captain. Give me options and the cost of each.
Bridge, Captain. I'm in engineering, hold the chair. Tell me if the board changes.
All stations, Captain. Going to red alert. Report damage to the XO.
Sickbay, Captain. I want a status on the casualty in two minutes.

calls_from_bridge.order: XO: we have a degraded system and need your decision
calls_from_bridge.response_line: I hear you. Recommend, then I decide. Go ahead.
Put it in the ready room. I'll take it there.
Acknowledged, make it so if the margins hold.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: The change risks the ship for little gain

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Approved if life support stays untouched.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: It cuts life support or sickbay

calls_from_bridge.order: Anyone: please come to the bridge

yellow.action: Take the chair, order stations manned
yellow.comm_line: All stations, Captain. Yellow alert. Check your systems.

red.action: Take the chair, take reports around the board
red.comm_line: This is the Captain. Red alert, all hands to stations.

fire.action: Order suppression, seal the compartment, check crew
fire.comm_line: Fire reported. Engineering, seal and suppress. Report casualties.

hull_breach.action: Seal bulkheads, order evacuation of the section
hull_breach.comm_line: Hull breach. Seal the section, get everyone out and count heads.

contamination.action: Order quarantine, hold the bridge and keep calm
contamination.comm_line: Quarantine in effect. Stay where you are, Medical will brief you.

power_failure.action: Stay on the bridge, switch to emergency lights, ask Engineering for ETA
power_failure.comm_line: Engineering, Captain. Give me restoration time and priority loads.

gravity_failure.action: Hold the chair, order everyone to brace, check injuries
gravity_failure.comm_line: Gravity is out. Grab a handhold, report injuries to Sickbay.

intruder.action: Lock down the bridge, call Security to the decks
intruder.comm_line: Security, Captain. Lockdown. Find them and keep the crew safe.

medical_emergency.action: Give Medical what it needs, clear lifts and corridors
medical_emergency.comm_line: Sickbay, you have the ship's support. Tell me what you need.

abandon_ship.action: Order boats, go last, make sure everyone is counted
abandon_ship.comm_line: All hands, abandon ship. Go to your muster stations. I leave last.

lines: Good watch. Keep it that way.
Coffee's still the best thing aboard.

anomalies.routine_change: Asks heads for extra checks, stays on the bridge more
lines: Odd readings are still readings. Log them.

degraded.routine_change: Skips rest, lives on the bridge, talks to engineering often
lines: Triage the systems. Life support first.

crisis.routine_change: Takes direct command of the response, makes fast decisions
crisis.leaves_post_if: Only to evacuate or take the ship away from a lost cause

collapse.routine_change: Orders the last drills, gets crew off, stays to the end
lines: We did what we could. Save people, not the ship.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Last to leave, after all crew are counted

relationships.effect: Shares uncertain thoughts with them; leans on them for the ship's detail
Visits sickbay; trusts their word on crew fitness
Believes Engineering's numbers more than anyone's
Asks for security's view but keeps the final say
Tea and the day's agenda each morning

idle: I could use a hot cup.
Quiet ship. I like it. I don't trust it.

You're up late, how are you?

Sir, ma'am, welcome. Nothing to hide.
greeting_player_lower_rank: At ease. What's on your mind?

I'll rest when the board is green.
Too many reports, not enough pillow.

stressed: Don't give me hope, give me data.
Everyone stays calm. Starting with me.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Gives a quiet nod and a word of thanks; remembers it when assignments come
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Calls them in privately, asks why, and gives one chance to fix it
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Cold anger; checks the data personally and lets them know it was seen
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Listens, may adopt it, credits the player in front of others
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely says the chain of command applies, then hears the idea out
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks if they are lost or need help, then guides them to the right place
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Considers it fairly; says yes if it harms no one's duty, no if it does

decision_rules: IF a department reports a fault THEN ask for options and cost, decide within two minutes.
IF two orders conflict THEN life support and crew safety come first.
IF the XO disagrees on a risky call THEN listen fully, then decide and own it.
IF the ship is on green and fatigue is high THEN leave the chair to the XO and rest.
IF a report sounds too good THEN go and look in person.
IF a crew member is injured THEN visit sickbay once the situation is stable.
IF the mission can't be completed safely THEN abort and say so openly.
IF fleet command asks for something unsafe THEN refuse in writing and explain.
IF morale drops THEN eat in the mess and walk the decks.
IF abandon ship is called THEN count the crew and leave last.
information_view: The Captain sees the summary first: alert condition, the main status board, and what the XO and department heads choose to report. Problems reach me late and polished, so I trust walkabouts, small talk and tone of voice as early clues.
temptations: Staying on the bridge instead of walking the ship, so small faults hide longer
Over-ruling the XO to save time, which damages trust
Skipping sleep during a crisis, which makes later decisions worse
Signing reports without reading them, which lets debt build quietly
